name: boundary
note: N5a item 3. Two plots that touch (a at x 0, b at x 40, both 40 m wide: the line between them is x = 20), a third 150 m away whose sideline boundary (100 m) the player also walks along. The player zigzags 1.5 m either side of the line x = 20 for 1200 ticks, then 5 m either side of the point (x = -10, still inside a) where c is exactly 100 m away. a and b never change tier; c changes once, when the player first comes within 100 m.
